concerns.location: tasks.md: Dependencies section — 'T007 can run in parallel with T008 after T006'
concerns.text: T007 produces the FNR threshold / correction-factor decision (FR-010), but T008 computes the final per-group Prompt Adherence Rates and writes final_analysis.csv without reading fnr_threshold.json or correction_factor_log.json. If T007 runs in parallel with (or after) T008, the FR-010 conservative correction can never be applied to the reported rates. Either T007 must precede T008 and T008 must consume its outputs, or T008 must be split so the correction is applied before final_analysis.csv is written. As stated, the declared parallelism creates a consumer-before-producer flow for the correction factor.

T007 says 'run the detector on the held-out validation scenes (data/raw/validation_scenes.csv processed through the same pipeline) to estimate the False Negative Rate', but no task generates images for the validation scenes — T005 generates only for the N=100 main scenes. The detector consumes images; there is no producer task for validation-scene images (nor physics JSONs/prompts for them beyond T001's CSV). Add a generation step for the validation split (or explicitly reuse main-scene images with known ground truth) before T007 can execute.
